text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: More, more, more!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haaaaa!

We're halfway through summer camp,
and
everyone is busy honing their minds
and bodies
for the next race...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

Mihono Bourbon is also training hard to
surpass
the 3,000-meter benchmark for
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative! I have an adequate amount of
stamina
remaining.
choice_data_list: Want to rest for a bit?

text_block_list.text:
She had an amazing showing at the
Japanese
Derby.

She's been eagerly preparing to tackle
the Kikuka
Sho, but lately, she hasn't
been feeling her best
for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Again, my results are worse than
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have felt unwell for a duration of two
days. Yet
my analysis has determined no
definite cause.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not detect any problems with the
training
flowchart either.

But the sun has already set, and we can't
stay on
the beach forever.

I manage to urge the bewildered Mihono
Bourbon
to head back to the campsite.
She approaches me
again later at night.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I would like to discuss
something.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I consulted some medical books
regarding various
symptoms, such as
increases in anxiety,
irritability, and
accumulation of fatigue.
choice_data_list: I'll listen to whatever you have to say.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
After completing my analysis, my current
status
has shifted to "unsure."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I procured data from
my
previous training that shows similar
results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Before my debut, my 3,000-meter run
time was
thrown into great disarray
despite all the training
I had done. This
is the data from that day.

Mihono Bourbon's previous trainer
wanted to
develop her into a sprinter,
forcing her to go to
great lengths to try
and change his mind.

She attempted to run 3,000 meters, but

inevitably failed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Such a result was natural considering my
ability at
the time. I accept that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, as illogical as it may be, a few
days
ago, I began feeling the same
chilling sensation in
the pit of my
stomach that I felt on that day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Such a thing has never happened to me
before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But now, those memories keep repeating

themselves in my head...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The usual calm and collected demeanor
that I
have during training that was set
by default has
now seemed to vanish.

I've never seen Mihono Bourbon this
dispirited.

I decide that she needs a quick change
of pace
and spring into action.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The mountain breeze feels so cool,
Trainer.

It might be due to the nearby stream or
because
we're in a valley, but it is
indeed cool and
refreshing outside.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Lactic acid production is being
suppressed by the
influence of negative
ions. Thiamine consumption
decreasing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on stability of mental and physical

functions, status updated to "relaxed."

Registering mountain climbing as an
effective
method of achieving "a change
of pace."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your suggestion, Trainer.
This will
be of use in my future training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You often provide me with a variety of

information not found in my data logs.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it helped you refresh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For example, I was only able to achieve

consistent lap times for 1,600-meter
races with
your advice.

Now that you mention it, something like
that did
happen shortly after we first
met.

I couldn't just stand by and let her
continue
following such a haphazard
training method, so I
suggested that she
focus on her lap times.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...My emotional status has shifted to
"happy."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your advice has been invaluable. I am
certain this
brings me one step closer to
the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
By placing your faith in me, you were
able to
implement great updates to my
system.

To be honest, I thought long distances
would be
difficult for her at the time.

I only advised her to be conscious of her
lap times
because I couldn't stand seeing
her push herself
so recklessly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Status—"shock."
choice_data_list: ...Truth is, I thought you should stick to sprints.

text_block_list.text:
She was already known as a promising
sprinter
back when we first met.

With her naturally powerful physique
and
developed fast-twitch muscle fibers,
she was
actually far better at sprints.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But this information presents a
contradiction.
Why did you scout me,
then?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I did?

As I watched her give it everything she
had, I
suddenly found myself wanting to
believe in her.

Bit by bit, my memories are coming back
to me.
choice_data_list: That's exactly why I scouted you.

text_block_list.text:
The day she finished first in a
2,000-meter race,
the day she made the
world realize that she had a
shot at the
Classic Triple Crown tour...

Mihono Bourbon turned what seemed to
be a wild
fantasy into a lucid reality.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That's only because your instructions
were
extremely effective, Trainer.

Her hard work has the power to make
anyone a
believer.
choice_data_list: No, it's the result of your own hard work.
No, it's the result of your own hard work.

text_block_list.text:
I know that, without a doubt, she'll be
ready for
the Kikuka Sho.
Mihono Bourbon looks at me in shock.
choice_data_list: I believe you have what it takes to run the whole distance.
I believe you can run all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you... you believe in me.
We finally reach the mountain's summit.

Mihono Bourbon is enveloped in the
light of the
sunset.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Data recovery confirmed. New
"awakening" has
occurred.

With that, Mihono Bourbon raises her
head and
looks forward with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I have worked toward the
Classic
Triple Crown through sheer "will."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This "will" was acquired when I was a
child. It is
powerful and unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, I am certain that this
powerful
phenomenon inside of me is
worthy of your faith.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will move forward with confidence and
take on
the Kikuka Sho by using the
methods that have
gotten us this far.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In order to run 3,000 meters and
emerge
victorious, I believe this is the
optimal action to
take.

It could be on account of the setting
sun, but her
blue eyes are now shining
with a mighty vermilion
hue.
The next day...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status updated from "unsure" to
"confident." I am
able to perform any
type of training today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best, Trainer.

Not wanting to let her enthusiasm go to
waste, I
quickly assign her some training
tasks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Initiating intense
weight
lifting.
choice_data_list: Beach running to the absolute limit

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Accumulation of lactic acid has been
detected,
but limits have not been
reached.
Bourbon trains her hardest until sunset!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Initiating intense
running
on the beach.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have discovered that running by the
ocean
offers a beautiful view and can be
classified as
"enjoyable."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For reasons unknown, I was unaware of
this until
now.
Bourbon trains her hardest until sunset!
